Aiming to be the World Leader in
the Non-Ferrous Metals Industry
 The SMM Group, which inherited the copper smelting and refining business that was the original business
 of the Sumitomo Group, has continued to deliver value to society through its businesses for more than 430
 years, even as the times have changed. The “Shin” 3-business Collaboration Business Model, in which our
 three businesses, Mineral Resources, Smelting & Refining, and Materials are organically interconnected, is
 the culmination of the history and expertise we have built over the years and a source of strength that
 enables us to shape the future. Through the pursuit of technological excellence and by taking on social
 challenges, we aspire to remain one step ahead at all times. Our long-term vision of “becoming the world
 leader in the non-ferrous metals industry” is to grow into a company that others will one day aspire to
 follow. With pride in our heritage and a strong sense of mission, we will continue to create new value and
 contribute to the realization of a sustainable future.

 realization of a circular economy and a carbon-neutral society, thereby creating sustainable value.

 evolving global issues and the growing complexity and sophistication of expectations on corporations.

029          Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd. Integrated Report 2026
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd. Integrated Report 2026


 3-Year Business Plan (Changes in the Management Strategy and the Business Strategy)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Contents
 We have been focusing on strengthening our corporate structure through corporate culture reforms and a selection-and-concentration strategy from the Corporate Revitalization Plan (FY2000 to FY2001), created in
 the year after the JCO criticality accident in 1999, through the 2001 2-Year Business Plan (FY2002 to FY2003). Under the 2003 3-Year Business Plan (FY2004 to FY2006) and beyond, we have been pursuing growth
 strategies and have implemented large-scale projects, including the establishment of a 450 thousand-ton electrolytic copper capacity structure, participation in the Cerro Verde Copper Mine project, and construction of
 the HPAL facility in the Philippines. In recent years, projects we focused efforts on primarily during the period covered by the 2021 3-Year Business Plan (FY2022 to FY2024), including Cote Gold Mine and Quebrada                Introduction
 Blanca Copper Mine, have begun to contribute to our business performance. We positioned the 3-Year Business Plan 2027 (FY2025 to FY2027) as a critical step toward inheriting these initiatives and achieving the
 long-term vision.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   SECTION 01
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Future Envisioned by Sumitomo Metal Mining
                         2018 3-Year Business Plan (FY2019 to FY2021)                                                                      2021 3-Year Business Plan (FY2022 to FY2024)

  Long-Term                                                                                                            Long-Term
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     SECTION          02
    Vision

 3-Year Business Plan 2027
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Contents
 The three-year period from FY2025 to FY2027 covered by the 3-Year Business Plan 2027 comes at a critical juncture for realizing our Long-Term Vision to “Become the world leader in
 the non-ferrous metals industry,” during which we will enhance our MONOZUKURI-RYOKU (manufacturing and operational capability) to regain profitability and rebuild a foundation to
 sustainably increase corporate value. Under the 3-Year Business Plan 2027, we will also actively pursue initiatives to “sow the seeds” for future growth while simultaneously overcoming current                                                                                                                                                                                                Introduction
 issues, thereby aiming to realize our Vision for 2030 and our Long-Term Vision to “Become the world leader in the non-ferrous metals industry.”

      Corporate Philosophy Dissemination                                                                                       Enhancing Safety Culture

 To help achieve the goal of “fostering a corporate culture with a unifying force based on our Corporate Philosophy,”        As a manufacturing company, safety is the top priority and underpins our Group’s business           Introduction
 as outlined in the 3-Year Business Plan 2027, we introduced the “SMM Corporate Philosophy Dissemination Program”            foundation. We will advance safety initiatives with labor and management united toward our
 in FY2024. This program aims to help participants internalize Sumitomo’s history, corporate spirit, and corporate           goal of zero serious accidents.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 SECTION 01
 philosophy and apply them to their daily decision-making and work. In FY2024, it was conducted for newly appointed                                                                                                              Future Envisioned by Sumitomo Metal Mining

 Water is a shared resource for the region, closely connected to the lives of residents and communities,                                                                                                                                                          SECTION 05
 and has an impact on surrounding ecosystems. Under the Sumitomo Metal Mining Group’s Water Policy,                                                                                                                                                               Data Section
 we identify water risks not only using tools such as the WWF Water Risk Filter and WRI Aqueduct, but
 also by considering water use and the impact on the surrounding environment at each business site.
 We work to reduce these risks while considering local communities and the environment in the water
 areas we use and take responsible action to make effective use of limited water resources. For example,
 at CBNC on Palawan Island in the Philippines, where water shortages are common during the dry season,
 supernatant water collected in tailings storage facilities is reused in production processes. In addition,
 this water is supplied as industrial water to a lime slurry manufacturer that is a supplier to CBNC, as part
 of efforts to make effective use of water resources. As a contribution to local communities, CBNC also
 provides, maintains, and manages water supply facilities, and continues to deliver drinking water using

                                          SMM views corporate governance as a disciplinary framework both for maximizing the corporate value of the SMM Group and for ensuring sound management practices. As such, it is one of the most
                                          important management issues. SMM has established the SMM Group Corporate Philosophy based on the Sumitomo Business Spirit. Through striving to enhance our corporate governance, we will
          Basic Approach                  conduct efficient and sound business activities, make positive contributions to society, and fulfill our responsibilities to our shareholders and all other stakeholders in order to realize the SMM Group
                                          Corporate Philosophy.                                                                                              Corporate Governance Guidelines https://www.smm.co.jp/en/ir/management/governance_policy/
